column2: Extended autonomous work mode: inspects the project, then implements, tests and commits for hours, stopping only for irreversible decisions.
Turns a React + PostgreSQL web app into a premium Expo iOS/Android app (audit, design system, exams, server guards, APK, stores), then keeps building it in autonomous mode.
Redesigns one existing page for the best UX: captures it, keeps a contract of what it must still do, rebuilds it in your stack, checks the real render at three widths.

Finds a free, legally usable image for a blog article across Pexels, Pixabay, Unsplash, Openverse and Wikimedia, downloads it as WebP with its credit line, never reuses one; CLI and HTTP API for pipelines.
Shields an nginx server from distributed scrapers: reads the logs, finds the networks a bot rotates its addresses through, closes them at Cloudflare; never a search engine or an access provider.

Keeps a project moving across several sessions, e.g. every night: relaunches autonomous-mode from a plan.md in its own worktree and branch, judges each session itself (commits, plan untouched, no deleted test, clean tree, check still green), never pushes or merges.
